scope: Existing canonical Poaceae taxonomy only: accepted names, synonyms, rank, authored homonyms and specimen/hybrid holds. No card enrichment, photo work, installation, genus/family lessons, county nativity audit, Pages or schedule changes.
related_accepted_species_not_installed_b: Paspalum racemosum Lam. (separate from Eriochloa sericea)

scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted Poaceae species at species rank in POWO/WCVP and FNA; keep one existing canonical Texas cupgrass learner concept.
Homotypic basionym according to POWO; preserve authored alias without duplicate card.
POWO/WCVP lists as homotypic synonym; preserve exact published epithet and POWO authorship form. ITIS authorship citation differs and is separately flagged.
Heterotypic synonym in POWO; historical alias only.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Paspalum racemosum Lam. versus P. racemosum Nutt.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO's 1791 Lam. and 1835 Nutt. records establish the earlier accepted name and illegitimate later homonym with distinct accepted targets; authorship must be retained.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Eriochloa sericea rank and published author
scientific_decisions.reason: FNA Volume 25, p.508, independently supports accepted author citation and treats no lower taxa; no infraspecific learner entry justified by this review.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Paspalum sericeum versus Paspalum racemosum Nutt.
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: HOMOTYPIC versus HETEROTYPIC under Eriochloa sericea
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO distinguishes the 1849 basionym as homotypic from Nuttall's 1835 name as heterotypic; neither should be misrepresented as identical name-bearing types.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed author-blind synonym merge of all Paspalum racemosum records
scientific_decisions.reason: An unauthored string cannot be assigned to E. sericea because P. racemosum Lam. is separately accepted; FAIL applies to blanket mapping only, not accepted taxa.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual learner photographs or observation IDs labelled Eriochloa sericea
scientific_decisions.reason: A verified accepted scientific name does not independently authenticate each photographed plant or establish a matching voucher. Preserve existing provisional identity and anatomy holds; no gallery edits.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual hybrid identification or ancestry for learner observations
scientific_decisions.reason: No examined taxonomic record establishes hybrid origin for a specific learner specimen; do not infer parents or change existing hybrid/science statuses.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical bare Paspalum racemosum without author/date/voucher
scientific_decisions.reason: Without authorship or underlying specimen, ambiguous historical Paspalum racemosum cannot safely be mapped to either Eriochloa sericea or accepted Paspalum racemosum Lam.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Panicum sericatum author string Steud. versus Scheele ex Steud.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO abbreviates this homotypic synonym as Steud.; ITIS cites Scheele ex Steud. Synonym target agrees, but exact original author citation not independently reconciled against 1853 protologue; preserve source-specific citation without changing canonical E. sericea.
